data.name: Pulsagon
data.detailed_description:
🎮 Pulsagon – A Rhythm Game of Perfect Shape and Precision

Welcome to Pulsagon, a high-speed, shape-shifting rhythm game where reflexes meet geometry in a dance of perfect timing. Every beat is a test. Every shape is a challenge. And every misstep? A pulse closer to chaos.

In Pulsagon, the music isn’t just background noise—it’s the battlefield. Shapes descend to the beat in all directions, and your job is to match their form and rotate your shield to meet them head-on. Sounds easy? You’ll be switching between Circle, Triangle, Square, Pentagon (and beyond) in milliseconds, all while staying perfectly synced to the pulse of the soundtrack.

🕹️ How It Works:

  • Use your mouse to rotate a 360° shield around a glowing central core.

  • Tap keys (1–4 or QWER) to instantly morph your shield into the correct shape.

  • A Circle can't stop a Triangle. A Pentagon won’t block a Square. Match shape for shape, beat for beat.

  • Some shapes don’t stop at one hit—you’ll need to stay focused for what's next…

🎵 Features That’ll Keep You on Your Toes:

  • Several handcrafted levels, each synced to original high-energy music spanning EDM, Chiptune, Glitch, and more.

  • Progressive difficulty curve: start slow, then dive into complex combos, fakeouts, and relentless beat streams.

  • Shape-switching madness that demands both mental agility and lightning-fast reflexes.

  • A crisp, minimalist aesthetic with vibrant geometry that pulses in time with the music.

  • No distractions—no story, no fluff. Just you, the beat, and your instincts.

Whether you're here to chase a high score or survive the last 30 seconds of a Very Hard track, Pulsagon will push you to think fast, move faster, and master the art of rhythmic precision. There’s no margin for error—only shape, sound, and symmetry.

Are your reflexes sharp enough? Hit play and find out.
